message.content: I ended my turn without building or unmortgaging anything. I kept my 4 houses each on St. Charles Place and States Avenue instead of upgrading them to hotels. That leaves the bank with only 2 houses, so gpt-6.1-sol, my only remaining opponent, can't build much more. Upgrading would have sent 8 houses back to the bank for little extra rent. I also held on to my $317 because the opponent's houses on Park Place and Boardwalk ahead of me charge rent of $1,100–$1,400.
message.reasoning:
This is a two-player game against p4, who has $60 cash but decent property. I have $317 and am on Free Parking, while p4 has built up Park Place and Boardwalk with 3 houses each, plus smaller developments on Pacific, NC, and Penn, with some mortgaged properties mixed in.

Those three-house hotels are dangerous, with rent up to $1400 on Boardwalk. Upgrading my own pink group to hotels would free up houses for p4 to build with, so I'd rather keep the bank's house supply scarce and block p4's growth instead. Unmortgaging railroads isn't worth it either since I can't afford all four and the income gain is marginal, so I'll just end my turn and hold cash as a buffer against the high rents I can't fully cover anyway.
